$comment: Installable IBM Bob lifecycle hooks of this collection. The Bob Config Importer extension and sync-workspace.js copy each hook's file into the workspace hooks folder and merge 'registration' into .bob/settings.json under hooks.<event> (matched by command).

hooks.description: Exports the Bob task conversation to task-history/ in the workspace root — the evidence input for the ai-regulatory-compliance skill. The export contains the complete conversation; run it only in a trusted workspace.
